properties.name: FIELD REPORT (a work project, 2026-09-14): `fix_without_recorded_cause` asked about 21 fixes with no cause — 20 were checksum dispositions wearing the nearest label, and the agent then ASKED THE OWNER whether to record causes at all. The graph holds information the agent did not know what to do with
properties.statement:
RELAYED by Anthony from a project at his workplace, 2026-09-14, recorded without the employer or domain. The agent there, answering the question reflow2 put to it (reflow2's own wording): "Twenty of the twenty-one changes recorded as fixing a defect or a failing test do not say what they fixed — the repair is in the diff, but the cause is nowhere, so none of them can be told apart from a fix that only treated a symptom. Should [the project] start recording the cause on every fix from now on, or is this a discipline the project is choosing not to take up?"

The agent's answer, in its words: "most of those twenty aren't really fixes. They're checksum dispositions I recorded while reconciling the design with the code, and defect_fix was the closest label. Only a handful — three genuine repairs — do have their causes recorded as findings." Then it PUT THE CHOICE TO THE OWNER: "A. Park the existing ones, record causes from now on (recommended). B. Go back and record a cause for each of the twenty. C. Acknowledge it — [the project] doesn't record causes. What would change my mind: if you'd rather not carry this discipline at all — in which case acknowledging it says so permanently and it stops asking."

ANTHONY'S OBSERVATION, twice, which is the finding: "the graph is recording information that the AI agent doesn't know what to do with. We may need to provide clearer direction to the agent for this type of information in the graph." And: "the agent shouldn't have to ask if it should record causes."

WHAT THIS SAYS ABOUT REFLOW2, four things:

(1) THE DETECTOR WAS RIGHT AND ITS POPULATION WAS WRONG. fix_without_recorded_cause counts ChangeEvents of change_type defect_fix or test_failure_fix with no CAUSES edge and no INVALIDATES. Twenty of the twenty-one it counted were not repairs; they were the ChangeEvents a two-sided checksum acceptance mints. Something on that path — the agent, or the tool's default — labelled them defect_fix. A detector asking "which fixes have no cause" over a population that is 95% not-fixes asks a question nobody can answer.

(2) THE change_type ENUM HAS `resync` — "the design caught up with the code" — and the agent reached for defect_fix instead. Whether set_artifact_checksums chooses the label, defaults it, or asks, is a measurement not yet taken; it is the first thing to measure.

(3) ⭐ THE GAP'S WORDING OFFERED "IS THIS A DISCIPLINE THE PROJECT IS CHOOSING NOT TO TAKE UP?" AS A LIVE OPTION — AND THE AGENT DUTIFULLY OFFERED OPTION C. Recording the cause of a fix is not a per-project preference in reflow2's design: rule:an-issue-is-root-caused-then-pinned-by-a-test-then-fixed is a DesignRule, the root-cause skill is served, and record_change's `repair` field exists so a containment is visible rather than forbidden. A gap that phrases a standing rule as an open question invites the reader to decline it, and an agent that has not read the rule cannot tell the invitation from a real choice. The question should have said: the discipline stands; here is how to triage the backlog that predates it (park it under one decision, forward-only — the parking clause the detector already honours); and here is how to tell a mislabelled record (resync) from an undisciplined one.

(4) THE GENERAL SHAPE IS THE THREE-LEG RULE FROM THE READER'S SIDE. The typed slot, the detector and the instruction all exist — but the instruction reaches the agent at the moment of REPAIRING, not at the moment of ANSWERING A GAP ABOUT OLD RECORDS it did not write. The gap text is the only instruction present at that moment, and it asked instead of told.

WHAT WOULD ADDRESS IT, not chosen here: (a) measure which path labelled the twenty defect_fix and fix it at the source, so acceptance events never enter the fix population; (b) rewrite the gap's description as a standing rule with a triage recipe, not as a choice — and sweep the other detectors whose descriptions offer "or is the project choosing not to" as an option where a DesignRule already answers; (c) the detector excludes acceptance-minted ChangeEvents by construction. TO DO after the current task, on Anthony's instruction.
